articles.title: Delhi HC Questions Wrestler's Asian Games Ineligibility
articles.summary: The Delhi High Court intervened regarding wrestler Vinesh Phogat's ineligibility for the Asian Games, questioning her exclusion. This action highlights the judiciary's role in ensuring fair opportunities for India's representatives and fostering athletic excellence, a crucial point for SSB aspirants observing national sports policy and governance.

articles.title: 7 snake-rich states in India and what every wildlife traveller should know about them

It underscores the Western Ghats' critical ecological importance and unique natural heritage for the nation, making it a key area for conservation.
